name: Local User Sandbox
description: Sandbox backend that runs exec and file tools on the Gateway host as an unprivileged local user

uid.label: Sandbox UID
uid.help: Numeric user id the tools run as (default: 10001). It needs no /etc/passwd entry and must not be 0.

gid.label: Sandbox GID
gid.help: Numeric group id the tools run as (default: same as uid).

home.label: Home Directory
home.help: HOME for sandboxed commands (default: /data/.sandbox-home). Keep it outside the OpenClaw state directory.
